ROLL BIG!

Move toward your mouse or finger. Eat smaller balls and dodge bigger ones.

Move your pointer or finger to guide the blue ball.

How to play & game modes

Guide the blue YOU ball into smaller balls to absorb them and grow. Survive for 60 seconds and aim for a high score.

On a computer, the blue ball follows your mouse pointer over the field. On a phone, touch or drag on the field to set its destination. You guide where it goes; it moves toward that point gradually.

In CLASSIC, colliding with a ball too large to absorb ends the game immediately. Avoid similar-sized balls too, and collect the smaller ones first.

In BOUNCE, larger balls knock you away instead of ending the game. Watch the direction of the rebound and keep growing for 60 seconds.

Absorbing a ball increases your score and size. Among balls you can absorb, larger ones give more points. BEST is the highest score for the selected mode, saved in this browser when a game ends.

During play, RESTART begins again with 60 seconds and a score of zero. QUIT stops the current game and returns to mode selection. Toggle music from the gear settings.
